export type ActionAudience = "user" | "agent" | "workflow" | "mcp" | "plugin";

export type ActionAvailability = {
    readonly available: true;
} | {
    readonly available: false;
    readonly code: string;
    readonly reason: string;
};

export interface ActionCallContext {
    readonly actor_id: string;
    readonly audit_actor_id?: string;
    readonly runtime_session_id?: string;
    readonly actor_kind?: "user" | "runtime" | null;
    readonly user_action?: {
        readonly source: string;
        readonly conversation_ref: string;
        readonly message_ref: string;
        readonly whole_confirmation_prompted?: boolean;
        readonly prompted_subject_id?: string;
    };
    readonly project_id: string | null;
    readonly audience: ActionAudience;
    readonly plugin_install_id?: string;
    readonly host_plugin?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/app-host").HostPluginCaller;
    readonly permissions: readonly string[];
    readonly allowed_capability_ids?: readonly string[];
    readonly allowed_actions?: readonly ActionReference[];
    readonly validate_authority?: (reference: ActionReference) => void | Promise<void>;
    readonly validate_permissions?: (permissions: readonly string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
    readonly on_progress?: (event: {
        readonly stage: string;
        readonly progress: number;
    }) => void;
    readonly scene_binding?: {
        readonly scene_id: string;
        readonly binding_id: string;
    };
}

export interface ActionClient {
    discover(context: ActionCallContext): readonly ActionView[] | Promise<readonly ActionView[]>;
    invoke(context: ActionCallContext, reference: ActionReference, input: unknown): Promise<unknown>;
}

export interface ActionDefinition<Input = unknown, Output = unknown> extends HostCapabilityDefinition<Input, Output> {
    readonly operation: "query" | "command";
    readonly provider_id?: string;
    readonly action: ActionMetadata;
}

export declare class ActionError extends Error {
    readonly code: string;
    constructor(code: string, message: string);
}

export interface ActionExecutionContext extends ActionCallContext {
    readonly beforeEffect: () => Promise<void>;
}

export interface ActionExecutionPolicy {
    readonly timeout_ms?: number;
    readonly cost?: "none" | "metered" | "unknown";
    readonly max_calls_per_minute?: number;
}

export interface ActionHandlerBinding {
    readonly capability_id: string;
    readonly version: number;
    readonly execution?: "sync";
    handle(context: ActionExecutionContext, input: unknown): unknown | Promise<unknown>;
    availability?(context: ActionCallContext): ActionAvailability;
}

export interface ActionMetadata {
    readonly title: string;
    readonly description: string;
    readonly kind: "query" | "judgment" | "operation" | "navigation";
    readonly scope: "home" | "project";
    readonly effect?: "read" | "write" | "irreversible";
    readonly plugin?: false;
    readonly scheduling?: "concurrent";
    readonly authorship?: "session";
    readonly execution?: ActionExecutionPolicy;
    readonly audiences: readonly ActionAudience[];
    readonly permissions: readonly string[];
    readonly subject_kinds: readonly string[];
    readonly input_schema: ActionSchema;
    readonly output_schema?: ActionSchema;
    readonly result_view?: ActionResultView;
    readonly input_type?: string;
    readonly output_type?: string;
    readonly workflow_content?: WorkflowContentStation;
    readonly search_source?: SearchSourceDeclaration;
    readonly file_source?: FileSourceDeclaration;
    readonly subject_offer_choices?: readonly SubjectOfferChoice[];
    readonly fragment_offer_choices?: readonly FragmentOfferChoice[];
    readonly required_scene?: {
        readonly scene_id: string;
        readonly version: number;
    };
    readonly result_scene?: ActionSceneReference;
    readonly required_actions?: readonly ActionReference[];
    readonly result_subject?: {
        readonly id: string;
        readonly revision?: string;
    };
    readonly background_job?: {
        readonly status: {
            readonly capability_id: string;
            readonly version: number;
        };
        readonly id: string;
        readonly input: string;
        readonly state: string;
        readonly done: readonly string[];
        readonly failed: readonly string[];
    };
    readonly undo?: {
        readonly capability_id: string;
        readonly version: number;
        readonly input: Readonly<Record<string, string | readonly [string]>>;
    };
}

export interface ActionProvider {
    readonly provider_id: string;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly kind: "system" | "plugin" | "mcp";
    readonly project_id?: string;
    readonly plugin_id?: string;
}

}

export interface ActionSceneClient {
    discoverScenes(context: ActionCallContext, judgment?: ActionReference): readonly ActionSceneView[] | Promise<readonly ActionSceneView[]>;
    usages(context: ActionCallContext, judgment?: ActionReference): Promise<readonly ActionSceneUsage[]>;
    targets(context: ActionCallContext, judgment?: ActionReference, scene?: Pick<ActionSceneTarget, "scene_id" | "scene_version" | "provider_id">): Promise<readonly ActionSceneTarget[]>;
    bind(context: ActionCallContext, binding: ActionSceneBinding, options?: ActionSceneConfigureOptions): Promise<void>;
    runScene(context: ActionCallContext, scene: {
        scene_id: string;
        version: number;
    }, bindingId: string, event: unknown): Promise<unknown>;
}

export interface ActionSceneConfigureOptions {

}

export interface ActionSceneDefinition {
    readonly scene_id: string;
    readonly version: number;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly description: string;
    readonly trigger: string;
    readonly scope: "home" | "project";
    readonly subject_kinds: readonly string[];
    readonly input_schema: ActionSchema;
    readonly result_schema: ActionSchema;
    readonly input_type?: string;
    readonly result_type?: string;
    readonly recommendation_source?: "subject-offers";
    readonly recommendation_labels?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
    readonly permissions: readonly string[];
    readonly configuration_permissions?: readonly string[];
    readonly event_schema?: ActionSchema;
}

export interface ActionSceneHandlerBinding {
    readonly scene_id: string;
    readonly version: number;
    bindings(context: ActionCallContext): readonly ActionSceneBinding[] | Promise<readonly ActionSceneBinding[]>;
    targets?(context: ActionCallContext): readonly ActionSceneTargetDefinition[] | Promise<readonly ActionSceneTargetDefinition[]>;
    bind(context: ActionCallContext, binding: ActionSceneBinding, options?: ActionSceneConfigureOptions): void | Promise<void>;
    prepare?(context: ActionCallContext, event: unknown): {
        input: unknown;
        state?: unknown;
    } | Promise<{
        input: unknown;
        state?: unknown;
    }>;
    consume(context: ActionCallContext, input: unknown, result: unknown, execution: {
        binding: ActionSceneBinding;
        state?: unknown;
    }): unknown | Promise<unknown>;
    failed?(context: ActionCallContext, input: unknown, error: unknown, execution: {
        binding: ActionSceneBinding;
        state?: unknown;
    }): unknown | Promise<unknown>;
    availability?(context: ActionCallContext): ActionAvailability;
    configuration_availability?(context: ActionCallContext): ActionAvailability;
}

export interface FragmentActionOffer {
    readonly offer_id: string;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly action: ActionReference;
    readonly input: unknown;
    readonly summary?: string;
    readonly editable?: readonly string[];
    readonly missing?: readonly {
        readonly field: string;
        readonly question: string;
    }[];
}

export type FragmentApply = "result" | "replace" | "insert_after" | "record";

export type FragmentGranularity = (typeof FRAGMENT_GRANULARITIES)[number];

export type FragmentIntent = (typeof FRAGMENT_INTENTS)[number]["id"];

export interface FragmentOfferChoice {
    readonly offer_id: string;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly intent: FragmentIntent;
    readonly apply: FragmentApply;
    readonly hint: string;
    readonly action: Pick<ActionReference, "capability_id" | "version">;
    readonly granularities?: readonly FragmentGranularity[];
    readonly roles?: readonly FragmentRole[];
    readonly requires?: readonly "goal"[];
}

export interface FragmentOffersInput {
    readonly fragment: {
        readonly object: {
            readonly kind: string;
            readonly id: string;
            readonly version?: string | number;
            readonly title?: string;
        };
        readonly granularity: FragmentGranularity;
        readonly targets: readonly FragmentTarget[];
        readonly heading_path?: readonly string[];
        readonly goal?: {
            readonly id: string;
            readonly title: string;
        };
    };
    readonly request_id: string;
}

export type FragmentRole = (typeof FRAGMENT_ROLES)[number];

export interface FragmentTarget {
    readonly kind: "text_range" | "block" | "object";
    readonly role?: FragmentRole;
    readonly ref?: {
        readonly kind: string;
        readonly id: string;
        readonly version?: string | number;
        readonly title?: string;
    };
    readonly text: string;
    readonly truncated?: boolean;
}

export interface HomeEvent {
    event_id: string;
    subject: ActionSubject;
    occurred_at: string;
    placement: "occurred" | "active" | "today";
    category: "personal" | "organization";
    title: string;
    summary: string;
    content: string;
    facts: Array<[string, string]>;
    needs_attention: boolean;
    open: HomeOpenTarget | null;
}

export interface HomeEventCollection {
    source: {
        surface: string;
        title: string;
        icon: string;
    };
    events: HomeEvent[];
}

export interface HomeEventView extends HomeEvent {
    id: string;
    source: ActionReference;
    origin: HomeEventCollection["source"];
    suggested_behavior_ids: string[];
}

export interface HomeEventWindow {
    from: string;
    to: string;
    now: string;
}

export interface HomeOpenTarget {
    kind: "item" | "group" | "surface";
    surface: string;
    id: string | null;
    title: string;
    label: string;
}

export type IntegrationProviderFailure = "needs_auth" | "configuration" | "network" | "provider" | "rate_limited" | "stale_history";

export interface IntegrationProviderItem {
    externalId: string;
    title: string;
    summary: string;
    body?: string;
    url?: string;
    occurredAt?: string;
    kind?: "message" | "notification" | "issue" | "pr" | "mention" | "update";
    priority?: "low" | "medium" | "high" | "urgent";
    tags?: string[];
    author?: string;
    attention?: false | {
        reason: "source_rule";
        detail?: Record<string, unknown>;
    };
}

export interface IntegrationProviderPort {
    readonly type: string;
    health(): Promise<{
        ok: boolean;
        status: "connected" | "disconnected" | "error" | "mock" | "needs_auth";
        message: string;
        action?: string;
    }>;
    sync(input: {
        cursor: unknown;
        mode?: "normal" | "rebuild_cursor";
    }): Promise<IntegrationProviderSyncResult>;
}

export type IntegrationProviderSyncResult = {
    ok: true;
    mode: "live" | "fixture";
    items: IntegrationProviderItem[];
    cursor: unknown;
} | {
    ok: false;
    mode: "live";
    failure: IntegrationProviderFailure;
    message: string;
    action?: string;
    httpStatus?: number;
    retryAfterAt?: string;
};

    views?: readonly UiContribution[];
    routes?: readonly PluginRouteBinding[];
    commandAvailability?(commandId: string): UiCommandAvailability;
    executeCommand?(commandId: string, input: PluginCommandInput): UiOpenedObjectView | Promise<UiOpenedObjectView>;
    onUpstreamReady?(inputs: PluginUpstreamReadyInputs, context: PluginInputDeliveryContext): void | Promise<void>;
    onUpstreamUnavailable?(reason: PluginUpstreamUnavailableReason): void | Promise<void>;
    onEvent?(event: PluginEventRecord, context: PluginEventDeliveryContext): void | Promise<void>;
}

export interface PluginArtifactClient {
    publish(input: PluginArtifactPublishInput): ArtifactVersionResult;
    read(reference: ArtifactReference): ArtifactVersionRecord | ProcessItemRecord | null;
}

export interface PluginArtifactPublishInput extends PluginProcessItemInput {
    origin: ArtifactOrigin;

    media_type: string;

export interface PluginCapabilityClient {
    availability(capability: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ActionReference): import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ActionAvailability;
    invoke<Input, Output>(capability: HostCapabilityDefinition<Input, Output>, input: Input, options?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/app-host").HostCapabilityCallOptions): Promise<Output>;
}

    references: readonly ArtifactReference[];
}>;

        ok: boolean;
        message: string;
    }>;

        from: PluginInstanceRecord;
        context: PluginUpgradeContext;
    }): void | Promise<void>;
}

}

export type PluginKind = "native" | "integration" | "app";

export interface PluginLifecycleReceipt {
    receipt_id: string;
    operation: "install" | "grant" | "start" | "upgrade" | "rollback" | "stop" | "crash" | "recover" | "uninstall";
    install: PluginInstanceRecord;
    at: string;
    replayed: boolean;
}

export type PluginLifecycleState = "installed" | "running" | "disabled" | "crashed" | "quarantined" | "uninstalled";

export interface PluginManifest {
    schema_version: 1 | 2;
    plugin_id: string;
    version: string;
    name: string;
    kind: PluginKind;
    publisher: {
        publisher_id: string;
        signature: string;
    };
    host_api_version: 1 | 2;
    entrypoints: PluginEntrypointManifest[];
    permissions: PluginPermissionDeclaration[];
    capabilities: {
        provides: string[];
        consumes: string[];
    };
    artifacts: {
        produces: Array<{
            artifact_type_id: string;
            schema_version: number;
            title?: string;
            preview?: {
                capability_id: string;
                version: number;
            };
            pin?: {
                capability_id: string;
                version: number;
            };
            compare?: {
                capability_id: string;
                version: number;
            };
            continue?: {
                capability_id: string;
                version: number;
            };
        }>;
        consumes: Array<{
            artifact_type_id: string;
            schema_version: number;
            continue?: {
                capability_id: string;
                version: number;
            };
        }>;
    };
    process_items?: {
        produces: Array<{
            artifact_type_id: string;
            schema_version: number;
        }>;
        consumes: Array<{
            artifact_type_id: string;
            schema_version: number;
        }>;
    };
    ui: {
        contributions: string[];
        embedded_plugins?: string[];
        views?: UiViewDeclaration[];
        commands?: UiCommandDeclaration[];
    };
    ports?: PluginPortsDeclaration;
    events?: PluginEventsDeclaration;
    routes?: PluginRouteDeclaration[];
    requires?: PluginRequirementDeclaration[];
    agent?: AgentManifest;
    methods?: import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin-agent").AgentSkillDeclaration[];
    upgrade_compatibility?: PluginUpgradeCompatibilityDeclaration;
    actions?: readonly import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ActionDefinition[];
    action_scenes?: readonly import("@molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/actions").ActionSceneDefinition[];
}

export declare class PluginManifestError extends Error {
    readonly code: "plugin_manifest_invalid" | "plugin_entrypoint_missing" | "plugin_permission_invalid" | "plugin_declaration_invalid";
    constructor(code: "plugin_manifest_invalid" | "plugin_entrypoint_missing" | "plugin_permission_invalid" | "plugin_declaration_invalid", message: string);
}

export interface PluginRuntimeApi {
    register(definition: PluginDefinition): void;

        install_id: string;

        preserve_enabled?: boolean;

        release_quarantine?: boolean;

    uninstall(installId: string, options?: {
        retain_private_data?: boolean;
    }): Promise<PluginLifecycleReceipt>;

    list(): PluginInstanceRecord[];

export declare const RESERVED_EVENT_NAMESPACES: readonly ["molis.", "host."];

export declare const SEARCH_ENTRIES_INPUT_SCHEMA: {
    type: string;
    properties: {
        cursor: {
            type: string[];
        };
        limit: {
            type: string;
            minimum: number;
            maximum: number;
        };
    };
    required: string[];
    additionalProperties: boolean;
};

export declare const SEARCH_ENTRIES_INPUT_TYPE = "molis.search.entries.window.v1";

export declare const SEARCH_ENTRIES_OUTPUT_SCHEMA: {
    type: string;
    properties: {
        entries: {
            type: string;
            maxItems: number;
            items: {
                type: string;
                properties: {
                    subject: {
                        type: string;
                        properties: {
                            kind: {
                                type: string;
                                minLength: number;
                            };
                            id: {
                                type: string;
                                minLength: number;
                            };
                        };
                        required: string[];
                        additionalProperties: boolean;
                    };
                    revision: {
                        maxLength: number;
                        type: string;
                        minLength: number;
                    };
                    title: {
                        type: string;
                        maxLength: number;
                    };
                    summary: {
                        type: string;
                        maxLength: number;
                    };
                    updated_at: {
                        type: string[];
                    };
                    content: {
                        enum: string[];
                    };
                    open: {
                        anyOf: ({
                            type: string;
                            properties: {
                                surface: {
                                    type: string;
                                    minLength: number;
                                    maxLength: number;
                                    pattern: string;
                                };
                                id: {
                                    type: string;
                                    minLength: number;
                                };
                            };
                            required: string[];
                            additionalProperties: boolean;
                        } | {
                            type: string;
                        })[];
                    };
                };
                required: string[];
                additionalProperties: boolean;
            };
        };
        next_cursor: {
            type: string[];
        };
        collection_revision: {

    readonly list: {

            readonly type: "array";
            readonly items: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
        };
    };

        readonly input: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
        readonly output: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
    };
    readonly receive: {
        readonly input: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
        readonly output: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
    };
    readonly create: {
        readonly input: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
        readonly output: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
    };
};

export interface WorkflowContentActions {
    readonly list: ActionDefinition<Record<string, never>, readonly WorkflowStartItem[]>;
    readonly read: ActionDefinition<{
        item_id: string;
    }, WorkflowPayload>;
    readonly receive: ActionDefinition<WorkflowReceiveInput, WorkflowItemRef>;
    readonly create?: ActionDefinition<{
        title: string;
    }, WorkflowItemRef>;
}

export interface WorkflowContentBinding {
    readonly provider_id: string;
    readonly actions: Readonly<Partial<Record<WorkflowContentRole, ActionReference>>>;
}

export interface WorkflowContentHandlers {
    list(caller: ActionCallContext): readonly WorkflowStartItem[] | Promise<readonly WorkflowStartItem[]>;
    read(input: {
        item_id: string;
    }, caller: ActionCallContext): WorkflowPayload | Promise<WorkflowPayload>;
    receive?(input: WorkflowReceiveInput, caller: ActionCallContext): WorkflowItemRef | Promise<WorkflowItemRef>;
    create?(input: {
        title: string;
    }, caller: ActionCallContext): WorkflowItemRef | Promise<WorkflowItemRef>;
}

export type WorkflowContentRole = "list" | "read" | "receive" | "create";

export interface WorkflowContentStation {
    readonly id: string;

    readonly icon: string;

    readonly protocol: 1;
    readonly receives?: false;
}

    readonly title: string;

    readonly source?: string | null;

}

    readonly payload: WorkflowPayload;

        readonly instance_id: string;
        readonly step: number;
        readonly title?: string;
    };
}
